value: **Embodied & Participatory Modeling**: Leverages embodied, mixed-reality, or physical role-play activities to ground learners' sense-making and computational modeling of complex systems. Evidence: "In this paper we explore the implementations of an activity designed to engage students in an embodied simulation of an artistically expressive Agent-based modeling environment."
